description: Header file defining the t_client structure and functions for SRP client-side negotiation, including session management, key generation, and verification.

methods.name: t_clientopen
methods.description: Initializes an SRP client session with username and parameters.

methods.name: t_clientgenexp
methods.description: Generates a random exponent and computes g raised to that power.

methods.name: t_clientpasswd
methods.description: Sets the user's password in the client state.

methods.name: t_clientgetkey
methods.description: Computes the session key from server-provided exponent.

methods.name: t_clientclose
methods.description: Closes the session and frees resources.
